summary: Describes the RELATIONAL extension to the Sieve mail filtering language, adding relational operators such as greater than or less than to its tests. It can compare content and also count entities in header and envelope fields. It was replaced by RFC 5231.

eli5.summary: Mail filters can already check whether words match. This adds is it more than, or less than, so a filter can for instance react to how many addresses are on a message. It was replaced by RFC 5231.
